_comment: Phase-1 supported courses (platform entities), academic sessions and per-course session status. Course catalog detail lives in per-course files (ptb.json, federal.json, oxford.json, afaq.json, gohar.json, bapu.json).

courses.name: PTB — Punjab Curriculum & Textbook Board (PCTB)
courses.description: Government textbooks for Punjab public schools & colleges (Classes 1-12) under the Single National Curriculum. Official e-books are published free on the PCTB portal.

courseSessions.notes: New 9th-class books introduced (first year of the 2025 curriculum).
Current session: new 10th-class books introduced alongside continuing 9th-class books.

courses.name: Federal Board (FBISE) — Federal Curriculum
courses.description: Federal Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education. Federal schools follow National Book Foundation (NBF) model textbooks on the SNC/NCP.

courseSessions.notes: NCP 2022-23 based NBF books in use (SSC/HSSC).

courses.name: Oxford University Press Pakistan
courses.description: School textbooks & courses for Pakistan (SNC/PNC-aligned and international streams). Pre-primary to Class 8 school courses; secondary titles for O-level streams.

courseSessions.notes: Publisher catalogue cycle — not tied to government session dates.

courses.name: AFAQ Publishers (Association for Academic Quality)
courses.description: Private school textbook publisher. SNC-aligned series: Sun Series (New Edition), Iqbal Series, Nakhlah readers and workbooks, Classes 1-8.

courses.name: GOHAR Publishers
courses.description: Private school textbook publisher. Gohar SNC series (English, Nida-e-Urdu, Mathematics, Science, General Knowledge, Social Studies) and Spark SNC Mathematics, Classes 1-8.

courses.name: B.A — University of the Punjab (Affiliated Colleges)
courses.description: Undergraduate Arts programs examined by the University of the Punjab. NOTE: the two-year B.A./B.Sc. ANNUAL system has been officially replaced by 2-year (4-semester) Associate Degree programs and 4-year BS programs; legacy annual-scheme rows are kept as ARCHIVED reference.

classes.name: B.A (Annual System) Part-I — legacy scheme (replaced)
classes.notes: Superseded by Associate Degree (semester system). Kept for historical syllabus references.

classes.name: B.A (Annual System) Part-II — legacy scheme (replaced)
classes.notes: Superseded by Associate Degree (semester system). Kept for historical syllabus references.

classes.name: Associate Degree in Arts (B.A equivalent, 2-year / 4-semester)
classes.notes: Current replacement program (double-major with one minor, or subject-specific), semester system.

courseSessions.notes: Final years of the legacy B.A annual scheme; kept for reference.
Transition to Associate Degree semester programs.
Current: Associate Degree in Arts (semester system).
